laws.rule: Nagasaki City accommodation tax, with no lower threshold: until 31 March 2027, JPY 100 a person a night under JPY 10,000, JPY 200 from JPY 10,000 to 19,999, JPY 500 from JPY 20,000. From 1 April 2027: JPY 100 under JPY 6,000, JPY 300 from JPY 6,000 to 19,999, JPY 500 from JPY 20,000. JPY 100, 200, 300 and 500 are about A$0.90, A$1.80, A$2.71 and A$4.51 (RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82).
laws.heading: 長崎市宿泊税条例
長崎県青少年保護育成条例 (the text calls it 少年, juvenile), curfew for young people
laws.rule: Nagasaki's Nagasaki Juvenile Protection and Development Ordinance (長崎県青少年保護育成条例 (the text calls it 少年, juvenile)), art. 13. The ordinance sets the late-night period as 11 pm to 4 am. A guardian must make sure that a young person (generally under 18) who goes out in that period is accompanied by the guardian or by an adult the guardian asks, unless there is a necessary reason. Anyone else is barred from taking such a young person out, going about with them or keeping them out in that period without the guardian's consent or another proper reason. The penalty clause for others was not extracted here. Yen at A$1 = JPY 110.82 (RBA, 30 Oct 2026).
